So determinant = (-1)^(1+2)*0 * M12 + (-1)^(2+2)*0 * M22 + (-1)^(3+2)*2 * M32 + (-1)^(4+2)*3 * M42 + (-1)^(5+2)*(-4) * M52 + (-1)^(6+2)*(-2) * M62. Since (-1)^(i+2) = (-1)^i. So signs: for i=3: (-1)^3 = -1, so term = -2 * M32. i=4: (-1)^4=+1, so +3 * M42. i=5: (-1)^5=-1, so -(-4)*M52 = +4 * M52. i=6: (-1)^6=+1, so +(-2)*M62 = -2 * M62. So det = -2*M32 + 3*M42 + 4*M52 -2*M62.
